visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from bold blue solid backgrounds with prominent feature cards (2020) through gradient-heavy, colorful hero sections emphasizing social proof (2022), toward increasingly minimal and refined layouts with subtle gradients and content-forward design (2024). The current live state reflects a system error rather than production design.
